name: Sird
source:
Sird is a gold om'verai with a unknown color of eyes, decorated by 2 thin head horns and some thin back spikes. Sird wears a North-Sec agent uniform: both face, tail and neck are covered by black armor, eyes are covered with green lenses and there is a North-Sec chest symbol. Sird wears transparent paw gloves and light shoulder armor.
Sird is both a caring husband and father, who believes in Azaries' Aegisologist skills not to be wasted.
